news_inspiration: 奧地利維也納的大學科學家發現一隻名為 Veronika 的乳牛具備極其罕見的工具使用能力，打破了人類對牛隻智商的傳統認知。
荷蘭學生團隊研發出全球首款太陽能救護車，車頂配備可展開的太陽能板，能為 X 光機與疫苗冷藏設備供電並深入偏遠地區。
哈薩克中央大草原誕生了近 200 年來首隻在野外自然出生的普氏野馬幼崽，成為當地生態復育的重要里程碑。
prompt: A vertical poster composition featuring Chinese ink wash painting and sumi-e style on an aged silk scroll surface with visible silk weave, warm sepia patina, weathered paper stains, and delicate crease lines. In the center, a photorealistic black and white cat is depicted in a low angle view, gently holding an intricate antique brass key in its mouth, rendered with soft even illumination and butterfly lighting that casts a soft symmetrical shadow under its nose. The backdrop is an auspicious Chinese red and bright gold canvas with delicate cinnabar gradients and fine gold leaf accents, accompanied by a side calligraphy panel written in Traditional Chinese calligraphy characters and red seal accents. Multi-layered depth and ornamental border elements framing the scene like an East Asian movie poster. Clearly inscribed in elegant Traditional Chinese script in the corner is the text '2026-09-01 00:52 UTC'. IMPORTANT: any text rendered in the image (date/time, title, signs, captions) must use Traditional Chinese (繁體中文 / 正體字) glyphs or English only. NEVER render Simplified Chinese (简体字).

story: 古老寺廟的藏經閣木門前，狸奴正用口中銜著的銅匙探入鎖孔，為夜讀的盲眼老僧開啟重門。夜風拂過朱紅柱廊，泛著金箔碎屑的墨漬在古絹上暈開，靜默見證這場無聲的守護。
